verdict.rationale:
Checkout.com offers fast technical integration paths (Payment Links, Hosted Payment Page, low-code Flow, and an instant test-account signup) that could let a founder start accepting test payments quickly, but going live requires a sales-led onboarding process with custom, non-self-serve pricing ('get in touch with our team to create a plan') rather than an instant self-serve merchant account activation. This suggests the full go-live flow (KYC, contract, pricing) may not complete within a day, even though the dev integration itself can be quick.
missing for 10: documented self-serve signup-to-live-payment timeline, evidence of same-day merchant account approval/KYC completion.
